evidence.summary: DSH 技能管理插件，按来源浏览、搜索、新建、编辑和导入 Skill 文件，并提供文件开关、面板偏好与回收站。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 packages/dsh-skill-explorer/README.zh.md、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/cordis.patch.yml、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/package.json、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/access.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/client/api.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/client/index.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/client/locales.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/client/native-panel.tsx、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/client/panel/SkillsTab.tsx、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/client/telemetry.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/collect.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/frontmatter.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/import.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/index.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/loopback.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/pair-access.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/provider-toggles.ts、packages/dsh-skill-explorer/src/routes.ts；原生slot页面→SkillApi→受信HTTP路由→多根扫描/registry按rank合并；普通文件写声明，provider写面板偏好，名称/路径fresh重查。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
limitations: 定向核子包manifest/bundle、host/client/原生slots/API、来源扫描/rank/registry/两种toggle、写读/导入、共享fence与客户端心跳。未全审monorepo远程/SSH/Git、全部host鉴权/配对服务、整个zip格式/平台文件系统或真实会话刷新，不执行目标。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 为经常在多个Skill根维护普通文件的DSH用户集中浏览、编辑与导入；验收看正确文件和目标会话，非统一权限控制。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
原生slot页面→SkillApi→受信HTTP路由→多根扫描/registry按rank合并；普通文件写声明，provider写面板偏好，名称/路径fresh重查。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
定向核子包manifest/bundle、host/client/原生slots/API、来源扫描/rank/registry/两种toggle、写读/导入、共享fence与客户端心跳。未全审monorepo远程/SSH/Git、全部host鉴权/配对服务、整个zip格式/平台文件系统或真实会话刷新，不执行目标。
@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer 0.4.12，BSD-3-Clause；manifest DSH>=0.2.1-rc.3、web client和bundle，原生插件类型，未安装验收；README徽章不替许可证/包清单。
扫描/编辑/导入、备份与实际会话对账成本未知；半完成、原地编辑和链接布局增加恢复负担，非把接口成功数当收益。表见[Q04](#research-q04)。
只需支持字段的普通Skill文件维护者在备份测试根、确认无链接/并发写时单项试用，可信小导入逐项对账；字段丢失/错目标/状态未知/导入错误即停并查文件恢复备份，权限治理需求保持原办法。见[Q04](#research-q04)。
管理入口/文件操作有源码链；会话一致性、原子恢复和净节时未验，provider偏好不是模型撤权。效果表见[Q04](#research-q04)。
fresh身份、rank、随机wx原子toggle和wx导入值得复用；不能把它们推成内容CAS/全链接识别/整批原子。访问围栏与心跳是共享代码复用。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
来源合并、同名rank、管理GUI及fresh名称/路径、wx导入等改善文件维护；真实注入/权限仍归宿主，未证明每会话全覆盖或净节时。见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。
provider关闭只是面板偏好，汇总不等目标会话事实；编辑会丢额外frontmatter，链接识别有限、批量导入可半完成，限额有后验条件。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
未验证方向是预览版本/真实文件实体与导入实际结果对账，比较错目标、丢更新和失败恢复；已有fresh路径/wx/原子toggle与提示保留，简单补丁够用则否定独立插件。见[Q05](#research-q05)。
需要兼容DSH host/client服务、准确根与备份；远程paired路径依赖另一个服务，目标会话目录回读另核。表见[Q04](#research-q04)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)相对文件管理器是常规GUI/SDK整合novelty小幅9，非重要新方法18；[Q02](#research-q02)rank/fresh路径有局部机制8，但非真实scope/文件实体证明15；[Q03](#research-q03)共享围栏、wx与身份思路可条件迁移10，非跨平台普适15；[Q04](#research-q04)集中入口简化8，尚有手工备份/回读负担，未到11。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)相对手工找文件主要入口便利workflow小幅9，未改变分工到18；[Q03](#research-q03)新建/编辑交付仍Skill文件，delivery小幅8非新验收单元15；[Q04](#research-q04)非终端GUI和来源合并使管理可达reach10但依赖宿主，未到15；总管理成本/组织增量未识别，economics0，不用未知费用当节省4。

recommendation.reason: 维护简单Skill文件并能核完整diff的DSH用户，可在备份、确认无链接和并发写入的测试根试一次编辑或小批可信导入，复杂frontmatter保留原编辑办法。它比逐目录手工操作多来源汇总、fresh路径校验和导入跳过结果，但provider开关仅面板偏好、额外字段与实际会话及落盘须另核。出现字段丢失、错目标、来源或生效状态不明、导入错误时，应停写与重复导入，人工查真实文件并恢复备份，权限治理仍用真实provider配置。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)多根Skill文件维护人群/文件验收明确，超泛GUI用途15；维护频率与持续需求未实测，未到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)来源/rank和[Q03](#research-q03)fresh身份/wx导入超纯文件列表6；provider偏好/全局Map与手工恢复仍有限，未到可替代策略治理19。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)UI/API/host实际接线、[Q02](#research-q02)两个开关和[Q03](#research-q03)写/导入失败直接核超README/片段6；未跑宿主/链接/并发/解压实验，不到19。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)支持字段的简单文件备份/小样可回退，超专业不可控5；但[Q03](#research-q03)额外元数据丢失/原地覆盖/半完成和会话对账需人工，复杂文件不适用、工时未知，未到15。

publication.summaries.text: DSH 技能管理插件，按来源浏览、搜索、新建、编辑和导入 Skill 文件，并提供文件开关、面板偏好与回收站。

items.界面: 技能来源搜索、文件开关/编辑、正文导入与回收的原生Web管理面板

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 多源浏览 | 文件与registry合并、搜索筛选 | 跨workspace汇总/preset覆盖不等每会话完整目录 |
| 文件开关/编辑 | 更新frontmatter或正文 | 需真实目标/备份；provider开关仅面板偏好 |
| 新建/导入 | 可信Skill正文写入 | 资源文件不复制；整批失败可部分落盘 |
| 回收/界面偏好 | .trash与筛选记录 | 非编辑版本史/撤销全部副作用 |

publication.advice.text: 只需支持字段的普通Skill文件维护者在备份测试根、确认无链接/并发写时单项试用，可信小导入逐项对账；字段丢失/错目标/状态未知/导入错误即停并查文件恢复备份，权限治理需求保持原办法。见[Q04](#research-q04)。

      "path": "packages/dsh-skill-explorer/README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-skill-explorer · Visual Skill & Tool Explorer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)\n\nEnglish | [中文](README.zh.md)\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer?style=flat-square\" alt=\"Version\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.1--rc.3-4c6ef5?style=flat-square&labelColor=454a54\" alt=\"DSH\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square\" alt=\"License\">\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>Visual Skill & Tool Explorer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI & Desktop</strong><br>\n  <em>Tiered Skill Catalog · Model Invocation Toggle · Visual SKILL.md Editor · Safe Trash · Zero Intrusion</em>\n</p>\n\nA visual Skill Explorer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and desktop client: browse loaded skills tiered by source origin, toggle model invocation permissions, author new skills, and manage files through a safe trash mechanism.\n\n## What it does\n\n- **Sidebar row** \"Skill Center\" opens a native center-column page — a row in\n  the shell's own panel list, beside Plugins, Schedule and the task board —\n  with a tab bar. The row opens the page, and opening any session (or a new\n  chat) returns the center column to the conversation, exactly like the shell's\n  own Plugins and Schedule pages; the page carries no back control of its own.\n- **Skills tab**: skills grouped by source (system bundled / project\n  `.dsh/skills` / project `.agents/skills` / custom directories / user\n  `~/.dsh/skills` / user `~/.agents/skills` / runtime registered), with a\n  search box that filters by name or description as you type (name hits listed\n  first; Escape clears it) and stacks with the workspace picker. Each row shows\n  description, when-to-use, invocation marks, an enable/disable switch\n  (rewrites `disable-model-invocation` in the SKILL.md frontmatter,\n  hot-refreshed by the model catalog; a plugin-provided file has no such path,\n  so its switch is recorded in the panel's own store instead), a duplicate\n  action (a copy of the skill as a starting point in the create form), an edit\n  action and a delete button\n  (moves the file into `.trash`, recoverable). The refresh control hides while\n  a load runs.\n- **Filters and source folding**: the search box stacks with three facets — the\n  source groups to include, the enabled/disabled state, and the row marks\n  (\"Provided by plugin\" / \"No local file\" / \"symlinked\") — behind one toolbar\n  toggle that shows how many facets are narrowing the list. Each source group's\n  header folds and unfolds its rows; on first use only the project and user\n  roots are open, so the global sources do not paint every row at once. The\n  facets and the fold decisions are view preferences stored in `localStorage`;\n  a browser that refuses storage simply does not remember them.\n- **Import tab**: batch-create skills from a directory on the host or from a\n  `.zip` archive read by the browser. Every candidate is validated against the\n  official acceptance rule and resolved by the same source rank the list uses,\n  so a candidate a stronger source already provides is reported as skipped\n  instead of creating a file the model would never receive. An import only ever\n  creates files: an existing skill is never overwritten.\n- **Create tab**: a form to create a new skill under the user root\n  (`~/.dsh/skills`) or the project root (`.dsh/skills`), generating a\n  standard SKILL.md.\n- **Edit tab**: opens from a row's edit action, reads the skill through the\n  host (the list carries metadata only) and rewrites its description,\n  when-to-use and body in place; the name, location and enabled state stay as\n  they are.\n- Data comes from a filesystem scan following the official\n  dsh-skill-filesystem root conventions, merged with the `ctx.skills`\n  registry (bundled / runtime entries). The scan reads `customSkillDirs`\n  from this plugin's own config **and** from every live `skill-filesystem`\n  loader row, so the documented placement (the provider row in a profile\n  patch) is manageable too. The plugin never changes the skill loading or\n  injection semantics — it is a pure GUI management layer.\n- A skill the write routes cannot serve is badged by what actually backs\n  it, instead of silently missing its controls. A plugin provider that\n  reports a real instruction file (the official `SkillSummary.path`) is\n  listed as **\"Provided by plugin\"** — the file exists, it just sits outside\n  the skill roots this panel scans. Only a registration that reports no file\n  at all is listed as **\"No local file\"**. Both stay pathless, so neither row\n  offers an edit or delete control that would answer 404. A **\"Provided by\n  plugin\"** row does carry the enable switch (#1854): because the file belongs\n  to the provider, the host records the switch in the panel's own store and\n  the row reads as switched off (see the known limitations). Only a\n  **\"No local file\"** row has no switch at all.\n- A skill is listed only when the official provider would load it: its\n  SKILL.md declares a non-empty `name` and `description`, and the name\n  satisfies the official skill-name grammar. A file the official provider\n  discards is absent from the panel too, so the panel never shows a skill the\n  model cannot receive.\n- A duplicate skill name resolves by the official source rank (project\n  `.dsh/skills` 100, project `.agents/skills` 200, runtime 250, custom 300,\n  user `~/.dsh/skills` 400, user `.agents/skills` 500, bundled 600), so\n  the row shown names the same skill the model receives.\n\n## Install\n\n### From npm (recommended)\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer@latest\n```\n\n### From the repository (development)\n\n```sh\ngit clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git\ncd dsh-web\npnpm install\npnpm -r build\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-skill-explorer\n```\n\nRestart `dsh web` after installing; the \"Skill Center\" entry appears in the\nsidebar.\n\n## Routes\n\n| Route | Method | Purpose |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/list` | GET | Grouped skill list |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/read` | GET | One skill's editable fields and body (`?name=&path=`) |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/set-enabled` | POST | Enable/disable (rewrites frontmatter) |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/set-provider-enabled` | POST | Enable/disable a plugin-provided skill (recorded in the panel's own store) |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/create` | POST | Create a skill (user/project root) |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/import` | POST | Batch-create skills from a directory or a .zip archive |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/update` | POST | Edit an existing skill in place (name and location unchanged) |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/delete` | POST | Delete (move into .trash) |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/health` | GET | Health probe |\n\n## Security model\n\n- Every `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/*` route is loopback-only by default (the\n  shared plugin-family fence: loopback socket + Host header + browser\n  same-origin markers): unpaired LAN clients get `403 forbidden: loopback-only`\n  before any skill-file access. When `dsh-remote-web-ui` is also loaded, a live\n  paired-device cookie is an additional allow path (the same cookie `api/gate`\n  already checks); unpaired and revoked devices stay 403. The skill center does\n  not depend on the remote plugin.\n- Write routes accept the path displayed by the panel only as an identity claim;\n  before mutating, a fresh filesystem scan must resolve the same skill name and\n  exact path. Arbitrary paths and stale same-name fallbacks are rejected, so a\n  disappeared project skill cannot redirect a pending action to a user or\n  custom skill with the same name. The read route applies the same resolution,\n  so it cannot be used to read an arbitrary path either. The scan behind that\n  check resolves the workspace exactly as the list route does (explicit\n  override, then the active session workspace, then the process cwd), so a\n  write never re-scans a different project root than the one the panel served.\n- The edit route rewrites an existing SKILL.md in place and does not touch the\n  skill name or location; it carries the current `disable-model-invocation`\n  value over, so an edit can never silently re-enable a disabled skill. Linked\n  skills are refused here for the same reason deletion is (see below).\n- The plugin-provided switch route stores one `(provider, skill name)` pair\n  per record in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-skill-explorer/provider-toggles.json`\n  (atomic temp file + fsync + rename; a corrupt, foreign, or oversized\n  document degrades to \"nothing switched off\"). It never receives or writes a\n  path: the client sends the identity, never a location. Disabling requires a\n  fresh collection to still resolve that pair to a `provider-file` row, so\n  the store can only ever hold identities this panel actually showed; enabling\n  only removes a record, so it is allowed unconditionally and a stored record\n  stays removable after its plugin is gone. Both directions are idempotent, so\n  a double click or a retried request cannot stack duplicates.\n- The import route is the one creation surface that reads content outside the\n  skill roots, and its read set is narrow: a host directory the user names is\n  scanned one level for `<name>/SKILL.md` or `<name>.md`, symbolic links and dot\n  entries there are skipped rather than followed, or the browser posts an\n  archive it read. It writes only new `<skill root>/<name>/SKILL.md` files under\n  the documented user/project root, never rewriting an existing one, and the\n  request is bounded (archive 4MB, entries 512, one SKILL.md 64KB, 4MB of\n  expanded text). A malformed or unsupported archive (zip64, encrypted entries,\n  an unknown compression method, a path escaping the archive) is answered with\n  400 and the reason, and every refusal names the offending entry.\n- Skill content is user-authored markdown; the create form caps content at\n  64KB, and the edit and import routes enforce the same cap.\n- The panel renders skill descriptions with text nodes only (no HTML\n  injection).\n- Scans follow symbolic links: symlinked skill directories and single `.md`\n  links inside a skill root are listed as ordinary skills. Because a link\n  expresses the user's intentional mount, the target is not constrained to\n  fall inside a skill root; a symlink inside a project root (which may come\n  from a cloned repository) is treated as part of that project, and a\n  `SKILL.md` in its target directory is read and shown — this is the intended\n  trust boundary. Linked skills can be listed and toggled (rewriting the\n  target's own frontmatter), but **cannot be deleted**: deletion would move the\n  target's `SKILL.md` out of place, escaping the current skill root, so the\n  delete button is hidden for linked skills and the delete route refuses them\n  (400). For the same escape reason the edit route refuses linked skills too,\n  and the panel hides the edit button for them. Write operations still sit behind the loopback fence and the \"trust\n  only freshly scanned paths\" rule.\n\n## Known limitations\n\n- Project skills follow the workspace shown in the panel: the list route\n  accepts an explicit `?cwd=` override, and the create form sends the\n  displayed workspace; the project root is the nearest `.git` ancestor of\n  that workspace. The write routes resolve the same workspace the list route\n  serves, so a project skill stays manageable even when the host process cwd\n  is somewhere else.\n- Frontmatter parsing is a lightweight zero-dependency implementation\n  (block scalars, booleans, input nested block); exotic YAML features are not\n  supported — the official dsh-skill-filesystem provider remains the\n  authoritative parser.\n- The panel covers the filesystem roots it scans plus the global layer of the\n  `ctx.skills` registry (bundled and runtime entries). `customSkillDirs`\n  declared on a host-plane `skill-filesystem` row are scanned, because the\n  host reads that row's config; a skill that reaches an agent only through an\n  **agent preset's** own `customSkillDirs` or a preset-scoped provider is\n  outside that coverage, because the panel reads the registry without a\n  viewing scope. A skill absent from the panel is therefore not necessarily\n  absent from the model: the official `skill` tool catalog is the authority on\n  what a session can load.\n- The switch on a **\"Provided by plugin\"** row is a panel-local view\n  decision: it changes what this panel lists as invocable, not what the host\n  registry loads, so the model still receives the skill. Taking such a skill\n  away from the model for real means removing or disabling it where its\n  provider gets it.\n- Linked skills cannot be deleted (see the security model); enable/disable works\n  normally on them (rewriting the target's `SKILL.md` frontmatter). Both\n  directory and single-file links list normally; a single-file link (pointing\n  at one `.md`) is replaced by a plain file during the atomic rewrite — the link\n  is not kept and the target file is left untouched.\n- A directory import reads one level and does not recurse: a nested tree has to be pointed at the directory that actually holds the skills. A `.zip` import accepts `SKILL.md` at any depth, so a zipped folder of skills works, but other files in the archive are ignored rather than copied as resources.\n- Importing a skill whose name resolves at the same or a stronger source is reported as skipped (`exists` / `shadowed`) rather than replacing that skill; bringing such a name in means renaming the candidate first.\n- The fold and facet preferences are per browser profile and survive a panel remount and a page refresh, but not a different browser or an incognito window.\n\n## Telemetry\n\nThe browser half sends one anonymous install heartbeat per UTC day to dsh-market.com: a random localStorage id plus this package's name, nothing else. The server stores only a salted hash of that id, never IP addresses, and exposes aggregate counts only. See [docs/telemetry.md](../../docs/telemetry.md) for the full contract.\n\n## License\n\nBSD-3-Clause."

快速上手：一行命令通过 npm 或 GitHub 仓库地址直接安装 | [插件安装快速上手](#快速上手) |\n\n## 官方桌面客户端\n\n对于希望直接使用独立桌面应用的用户，推荐下载并使用官方发布的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop）。\n\n官方桌面客户端与 `dsh web` 共用 `~/.dsh` 数据目录，其 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all`（或 `@linxin666/dsh-web-all@latest`），点击安装；\n3. 安装完成后重启客户端，即可在客户端中使用任务看板、主题皮肤、远程控制等全套插件能力。\n\n## 创意工坊（dsh-market.com）\n\n[创意工坊](https://dsh-market.com) 是 DSH 生态的一站式资产分发平台，统一提供主题皮肤、桌面宠物、功能插件与社区 Agent 预设。所有项目按照真实设备点赞热度排序，皮肤支持即时试穿预览，插件提供一键安装命令。经典的 Blue Fantasy 蓝色幻想随皮肤插件内置，其余主题皮肤与宠物资产均可在工坊浏览、查看源代码并按需安装。在 Web GUI 的“创意工坊”设置卡中可直接浏览线上清单，皮肤与宠物可一键下载至 DSH 主目录并在对应设置页选用；社区预设下载至本地预设库，启用后即可在“设置 → Agent 预设”中用于新建会话。\n\n![DeepSeek Harness 创意工坊 dsh-market.com — 主题皮肤、桌面宠物与社区插件市场](docs/screenshots/31-market-home.png)\n\n创意工坊站点为本仓库的组成部分：前端为纯静态构建，由构建脚本 `scripts/market-build` 依据 `skin.json`、`pet.json` 与 `community.json` 等数据源自动生成；点赞等动态能力由 Cloudflare Workers 边缘函数与 D1 数据库提供支持（遵循单设备单票限制），代码合入 `main` 分支后自动触发持续集成部署。\n\n创意工坊旨在建立开放透明的社区生态，方便开发者分享作品并让用户自由选择所需扩展。\n\n## 功能插件\n\n### 任务看板（Task Board · 企业级后台长程执行引擎与多 Agent 自动化流水线）\n\n通过侧边栏“任务看板”进入。任务看板不仅仅是一个可视化卡片界面，更是 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Web GUI 与桌面客户端中的**宿主权威后台长程执行与多 Agent 自动化调度引擎**。任务按“待规划、待办、进行中、已完成、已失败”五列进行全生命周期管理，以 Schema v6 事务账本为权威持久化核心，真正实现了长程任务从拆解、分发、团队协作、对抗质检到外部成果闭环的全流程自动化：\n\n- **宿主权威后台驱动与 7x24 小时离线无人值守**：区别于传统仅在前端网页轮询的脆弱看板，所有卡片流转、调度触发与执行监控完全由 DSH 后端 Host 进程作为唯一权威驱动。浏览器仅为异步视图，关闭网页标签页、熄灭屏幕或断开网络，后台智能体会话照常并发执行与原子落盘结算。内置跨平台防休眠电源管理（macOS `caffeinate`、Windows `ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED`、带有 systemd-logind 的 Linux `systemd-inhibit`），允许显示器正常关闭的同时阻止整机因闲置休眠，确保夜间无人值守巡检与流水线准时打卡。\n- **多 Agent 树状级联并发与原生 Agent Teams 团队编排**：复杂工程目标可自由拆解为多层树状子任务（支持 1~3 层深度，内置环路与深度护栏）。**级联执行模式**通过受控准入队列（runLaunchWidth）并发派生多个独立智能体会话，自动跳过已在完成列的子任务，任一子任务失败自适应收拢整树状态；**原生 Agent Teams 模式**深度对接官方团队服务，启动专属 Team Lead 会话并在其内部为每个子任务动态孵化专属 Teammate，协同工具跨智能体联动，实现真正意义上的多智能体团队协同作战。\n- **对抗式双盲质量验收门禁（No False Completion）**：彻底终结 AI 编程中“自述已完成、实则未改动或改崩溃”的虚假交付顽疾。以 goal 形式执行的任务在 Agent 试图调用 `update_goal(complete)` 宣告完工的瞬间被 Host 强制拦截，必须由独立的裁判模型（可自选模型与思考档位）进行真实验收。验收机制沿用严苛的 Coding 质量判据、0.65 绝对通过阈值，每项判据双轮交换 A/B 位置打分消偏，并严格结合会话执行轨迹与宿主工作区真实磁盘文件的 Diff 行级变更审查。首轮未达标精准下发具象结构化问题引导 Agent 自我修复，两次仍不通过才判负，杜绝敷衍糊弄。\n- **全自动 GitHub Issue-to-PR 闭环研发流**：搭配官方扩展（`dsh-client-ui-task-board-github`），实现任务看板与 GitHub Issues / PR 状态的实时双向深度同步。远端 Issue 自动进入看板流水线驱动 Agent 读取需求、定位代码、修复 Bug 并运行测试，验收交付后全自动创建 GitHub Pull Request 并绑定 Issue 关联，PR 合并后自动关闭 Issue，打造全天候无人值守的开源与企业 Issue 自动化修复交付管线。\n- **长程目标驱动、会话持久化与冻结交接包（Freeze Handover）**：任务支持武装内置 `/goal` 引擎进行多轮自主续跑；周期性任务可开启会话复用，保留完整上下文记忆；支持通过 `<<<FREEZE` 协议将会话上下文一键冻结为包含“目标/进度/下一步”的结构化快照，并绑定工作区、预设与权限三元组，接手 Agent 瞬间无缝继承前序成果，同时内置提示词注入防御与来源审计。\n- **企业级权限基线、安全确认门与消费熔断保护**：任务可细粒度钉住工作区、Agent 预设、沙箱权限、执行模型与推理思考强度，钉子校验失败即 Fail-Closed；超出安全基线的高权限操作设有「人工确认门（Permission Gate）」，未在 Web 界面显式放行前坚决拒绝执行与调度，杜绝 Agent 越权危害宿主系统；支持配置看板级每日 Token 消费预算上限（`spendBudgetTokens`），防止后台死循环产生意外费用。\n- **面向智能体的双向工具面与外部成果统一**：向大模型完整暴露 8 个原生工具（`task_board_list`、`task_board_get`、`task_board_create`、`task_board_update`、`task_board_set_parent`、`task_board_run`、`task_board_manage`、`task_board_schedule`），赋予对话中的 Agent 自身查看看板、分解子任务、编排流水线与自动化调度的全套能力；同时支持通过 `record-external-outcome` 统一登记在 Claude Code、Codex 等外部工具中完成的工作，让异构开发流统一汇总至一张看板。\n\n| 多列看板与智能体协作 | 后台定时调度与参数配置 |\n| --- | --- |\n| ![DeepSeek Harness 任务看板界面 — AI 运行时与高效调度引擎）\n\n在新建会话输入框左侧通过专属老虎机拨杆切换，或在“设置 > Agent 预设”中选用。梁神模式（`dsh-liangshen`）是专为追求**极致推理效率、超低静态上下文开销与严苛工程执行纪律**而深度重构的杀手级预设与运行时插件。针对主流大模型在长程编程任务中容易出现的系统提示词冗长膨胀、工具 Schema 挤占上下文、思维链无效空转（如“流水账推理”）以及多轮遗忘退化等痛点，梁神模式通过原生极简提示词、程序化代码工具调用（PTC）、MCP 温和分页与关键事实局部就近投射，提供纯粹而强悍的编程作战体验：\n\n- **极简 Persona 与严苛行动导向纪律（Zero Prompt Waste）**：彻底剥离官方 Standard 预设中冗长繁琐的系统级条文，将提示词极致收敛为单行 Persona 与经过实战千锤百炼的高效工程纪律。内置反思熔断（同一假设推演不超过两轮，缺少事实立即闭合思考并调用原生工具探测，杜绝凭空揣测）、行动导向（思考过程仅用于决定下一步具体操作，严禁在思考中预演完整代码）、并发探索（单轮内并发派发多个独立检测或搜索工具）、YAGNI 与 PDCA 循环（单步验证单一假设，不写冗余注水注释）、以及有界收敛纪律（前置检查最多 2-3 轮即刻收敛，迅速转入实际作答或编辑）。大幅降低静态 Token 占用，让模型注意力百分之百倾注于业务与代码本身。\n- **程序化工具调用传输（PTC · Programmatic Tool Calling）**：彻底终结在每次请求中平铺上百个 JSON Schema 工具参数的低效模式。默认将网络线协议（wire）极致收拢为唯一的 `run_code`（运行 TypeScript 脚本），其余所有工具均通过自动生成的强类型 SDK 在独立的沙箱线程中以代码形式调用。无论系统注册了多少复杂工具，静态传输面始终保持极小体积；模型可原生利用 `Promise.all` 编写并发工具调用，并在程序内预先过滤、聚合、提取关键数据，只将精炼结论回传至对话上下文，从根本上解决大文本输出打爆 Token 的问题。对于习惯原生工具面的场景，亦可在插件设置中一键无缝切换为组装好的原生工具清单（Native）。\n- **MCP 工具温和分页与 LRU 动态激活（Gentle Tool Paging）**：针对海量 MCP 工具或第三方插件扩展，出厂默认启用温和分页（默认匹配 `mcp__*`）。外部工具在初始状态下仅以命名空间摘要形式登记在目录消息中，既不占 wire 协议也不进 SDK 声明；当大模型判定需要使用对应工具时，可自主调用 `tool_activate({ namespace })` 按需挂载。内置 LRU 策略（上限 3 个活跃命名空间），自动淘汰最久未用的命名空间，激活状态在会话压缩与恢复后完整重建，兼具海量工具接入能力与极致小巧的静态 Schema 面。\n- **关键事实登记簿与就近状态投射（Fact Register & Working Context）**：长程多轮对话中大模型极易遗忘早期的关键业务约束或踩过的坑。插件向模型提供专属 `fact_register` 工具，可将用户硬性约束、已确认的架构决策或失败路径登记为单行事实（每条不超过 160 字符，最多保留 12 条）。关键事实随 `[Working Context: ...]` 状态行在每一轮交互中就近投射至最新消息尾部的局部注意力窗口内，从物理机制上彻底解决长上下文“中间遗忘”与重复踩坑顽疾。\n- **原生调度者架构与敏捷访谈纪律（Dispatcher Identity & Triage）**：预设出厂深度集成调度者（Dispatcher）架构规范，赋能模型以团队指挥官身份统领工程任务。内置复杂度分诊机制（L0/L1 单点任务直接敏捷执行，L2 复杂任务严格遵循“澄清访谈 -> 架构规划 -> 并发子代理派发 -> 双层严格验收”标准流）；设定严格的提问预算控制（单轮最多 4 问、总计最多 3 轮、影响面排序、假设先行），杜绝无效拉扯；任务状态权威沉淀于 `todo_write`，杜绝浮躁的敷衍式交付。\n- **新建会话老虎机拨杆与炫酷中奖特效（Composer Slot Lever）**：在新建会话输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧，精心打造了一台复古老虎机拨杆控件。下拉拨杆（支持鼠标拖拽、单击或键盘快捷操作）即可一键为当前新建会话装配梁神模式，拉下命中即触发绚丽的中奖粒子特效（闪光、冲击环、火花粒子与专属彩蛋横幅）；上推即可平滑切回默认模式。拨杆自适应全局主题色彩，且在会话开始后自动隐藏，丝滑灵动，极具极客趣味。\n\n详细机制、评测数据与高级配置参数见 [dsh-liangshen README](packages/dsh-liangshen/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 移动端远程控制（Mobile Remote · 手机访问与跨设备触控优化）\n\n通过侧边栏底部的手机图标打开设备配对面板。使用手机扫码或复制链接配对后，手机浏览器将直接载入官方 Web GUI，并自动激活移动端触控交互层：轻触鲸鱼图标唤出侧边栏、支持手势左滑收起与右滑展开、长按会话项目呼出操作菜单、软键盘 Enter 键仅用于换行、输入框采用 16px 字体防止页面聚焦缩放。适合桌面屏幕的扩展面板（如 SSH 终端、任务看板、Git 图谱等）在手机端自动隐藏，聚焦于会话管理、模型切换、思考强度调整与消息收发，多端实时共享完整上下文状态。\n\n同一配对通道同样支持另一台 PC 浏览器接入：在远程电脑访问配对链接即可运行完整的桌面版 Web GUI。所有远程通信均受配对门控保护（走 `/remote/api` 路径），未经验证的访问将被拦截并仅显示提示横幅。配对令牌具备单次使用与超时失效机制，点击“停止”可立即吊销所有已连接设备。二维码默认基于局域网通信，搭配 cloudflared 等隧道工具可实现安全的公网跨网络访问。为确保安全性，使用隧道时建议走配对通道，不建议为隧道域名配置 `--trusted-host` 参数，避免绕过设备验证门控（详见[远程控制插件说明](packages/dsh-remote-web-ui/README.zh.md)）。\n\n![DeepSeek Harness 手机端与桌面端 Web ![DeepSeek 手机端模型切换弹层 — 多供应商与思考档位快速选择](docs/screenshots/23-mobile-model-sheet.png) |\n\n### 远程连接（SSH Ops · Web 终端、SFTP 传输与集群运维）\n\n通过侧边栏“SSH”入口打开远程运维面板。支持密钥与密码认证，可一键导入本地 `~/.ssh/config` 主机列表；配置数据安全保存在 安全地址；\n- **集群并发执行**：支持多主机批量命令执行，并可通过别名、运行环境或标签进行过滤；\n- **Agent 直连调用**：智能体与面板共享主机配置，在会话中发出指令即可委派 Agent 执行远程巡检与运维命令。\n\n### 使用统计（Usage Statistics · Token 消耗追踪、余额预警与 Token 银行）\n\n在“设置 > 使用统计”中集中查看 token 消耗数据、供应商余额以及编程套餐额度，支持自动定时刷新与手动即时查询。\n\n- **用量明细**：查看每日输入、输出与缓存用量，按不同供应商与模型细分展示，并提供最近 30 天消费趋势；支持的供应商提供账户余额查询，针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费与账单估算。\n- **个人套餐追踪**：实时展示 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、Codex / ChatGPT 等平台编程套餐的使用比例与重置周期。\n- **Token 银行**：所有 provider 每消耗 100 万 tokens 铸造 1 鲸元，以“鲸元券”形式展示台账周期内的累计 token 与调用指标，支持保存票券卡片与系统级分享。\n- **桌面宠物联动**：安装宠物插件后，可通过桌面悬浮挂件的气泡提示直接查看当前会话供应商的额度、余额或今日消耗。\n\n统计自插件首次启用起计，不回填历史数据；鲸元券统计台账窗口内所有 provider 的 tokens（消费行仍只来自 DeepSeek 官方余额观测）。支持的供应商列表与配置细节见 [dsh-usage README](packages/dsh-usage/README.zh.md)。\n\n![DeepSeek Token 用量统计与 Token 银行 — API 消耗追踪与账单估算](docs/screenshots/35-usage-token-bank.webp)\n\n### Git 图谱（Git Graph · 分支可视化与 Worktree 会话隔离）\n\n在对话输入框上方集成 |\n\n### 会话归档管理（Session Archive Manager · 全文检索与生命周期策略）\n\n会话归档管理（`dsh-session-archive`）是专为解决大量长短期会话堆积而设计的集中管理模块，随全家桶安装生效：\n\n- **集中检索与状态筛选**：统一呈现活跃会话、已归档会话、空白会话、子代理派生会话以及无工作区会话，支持按标题、工作区、状态及会话 ID 进行关键词搜索与多维排序；\n- **安全批量操作**：支持跨筛选结果的多选批量归档、批量恢复以及级联物理删除。执行物理删除时系统将明确提示受影响的后代会话数与预计释放空间，大批量删除需二次确认；当前处于运行中或带有运行中子代理的会话受到严格保护，防止误删；\n- **自动化生命周期策略**：提供两个默认关闭的自动化策略：根据最后活跃时间自动归档、根据归档时间自动清理超期数据，支持在启用前进行结果预览与单次手动执行。\n\n删除操作不可逆，所有管理路由严格限制本机回环访问。详细机制见 [dsh-session-archive README](packages/dsh-session-archive/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 暗黑沉浸风格预览](docs/screenshots/17-skin-blue-fantasy-dark.png)\n\n## 快速上手\n\n### 系统要求\n\n- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness 且 `dsh web` 可正常启动。\n- npm 安装方式无需额外环境；若从源码仓库构建，需要 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm 环境。\n\n### 三步上手（npm 安装，推荐）\n\n- **DSH Web CLI（现有浏览器服务）**：\n  1. 先完成三项构建脚本审批（见“安装排障”），再安装聚合包：`dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-all@latest`\n  2. 重启 `dsh web` 服务，侧边栏将自动呈现各插件入口\n  3. 打开“设置 > `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center`。若因包管理器门禁安装到旧版本，请参阅后文“安装排障”。\n\n### 从 GitHub 仓库直接安装\n\n仓库根目录声明了标准 `dsh.bundle` 装配清单，支持直接通过仓库地址安装，无需手动克隆代码与构建：\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add [docs/plugins.md](docs/plugins.md)。\n\n### 安装排障\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>展开查看常见安装与构建排障方案</strong></summary>\n\n<br>\n\n> **pnpm 严格依赖隔离导致模块找不到**：pnpm 的 isolated 模式默认仅将聚合包放置在顶层，部分子包可能被嵌套收敛，导致 `dsh web` 启动时报错 `Cannot find package '@linxin666/dsh-...'`。若遇到此情况，可在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中添加配置 `nodeLinker: hoisted`（或 `public-hoist-pattern: ['@linxin666/*']`）后重新安装。\n\n> **构建脚本被拦截 (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS)**：这三项审批必须在首次 add 之前就位。正确顺序是重置 profile（官方 `--from-default-profile web`）或换新 profile，把 `cloudflared`、`cpu-features`、`ssh2` 写进 `<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds`，再执行 add。装失败后补审批重跑会 exit 0，但 `dsh.profile.bundles` 仍无该行：静默半挂载，重跑修不回来。已带审批的存量 profile 升级不受影响。\n\n> **pnpm 11 发布时间门禁问题**：在包版本发布后的短时间内，pnpm 11 的默认安全策略（`minimumReleaseAge`）可能会尝试回退拉取旧版本。建议在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中排除相关命名空间以确保获取最新版本：\n>\n> ```yaml\n> minimumReleaseAgeExclude:\n>   - '@linxin666/*'\n> ```\n\n</details>\n\n## 兼容性与运行环境\n\ndsh-web 针对主流操作系统、现代化浏览器及网络拓扑进行了深度工程调优与兼容性保障：\n\n| 维度 | 支持范围与技术规格 |\n| --- | --- |\n| 宿主运行环境 | DeepSeek Harness CLI (`dsh web`)、官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop） |\n| 操作系统 | macOS (Apple Silicon M 系列 & Intel 芯片)、Windows 10/11 (含 WSL2)、Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch, CentOS 等) |\n| 浏览器与设备 | 桌面浏览器 (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox)；移动端现代浏览器 (iOS Safari, Android Chrome 等) |\n| 网络连接架构 | 本机环回访问 (127.0.0.1)、局域网多设备互联 (LAN)、公网隧道安全穿透 (Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale, FRP, Nginx 反向代理) |\n| 模型供应商覆盖 | DeepSeek 官方通道与满血模型、OpenAI (GPT-4o 等)、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、Kimi (Moonshot)、GLM (智谱)、MiniMax、Ollama 本地大模型、SiliconFlow 等 |\n| 运行时依赖 | npm 方式安装无特殊环境依赖；源码编译需 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm >= 9 |\n\n## 常见问题\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>安装重启后，侧边栏未显示插件入口？</strong></summary>\n\n请首先检查插件是否正确安装至 `web` profile（命令需包含 `--profile web`），并通过 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 验证配置层是否已成功挂载。注意仅刷新网页无法加载新模块，必须彻底重启 `dsh web` 后端服务进程。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>定时任务为何未能按时触发执行？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，无需保持前端浏览器页面打开。若宿主进程退出、系统关机或整机进入深度睡眠，错过的触发时间点将遵循跳过策略处理，不执行回填补跑；若任务到达触发点时上一轮仍在运行，会自动顺延至下一个周期。若需要允许息屏但防止主机自动睡眠，可开启任务看板自带的电源保护选项。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>手机端配对后为何没有收到流式推送？</strong></summary>\n\n流式推送走官方 WebSocket 通道，配对后经门控的 `/remote` 代理转发。隧道中断期间更新暂停，通道恢复后继续，无需重新配对；更新节奏的差异来自远程链路的广域网往返延迟。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>试穿主题皮肤不满意如何还原？</strong></summary>\n\n皮肤面板提供免落盘试穿功能：点击试穿即刻在当前界面生效预览，离开面板或关闭预览会自动恢复初始外观；只有显式点击“应用”按钮才会将主题配置写入磁盘，可放心预览各类主题。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>是否可以仅使用主题皮肤或某个单一插件？</strong></summary>\n\n完全支持。若仅需要视觉定制，直接安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center` 即可；若仅需特定功能，参考“单独安装某个插件”章节直接安装对应 npm 包即可。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>已安装全家桶的前提下，能否额外独立安装某个子插件？</strong></summary>\n\n可以。聚合包内部的插件注册标识均统一带有 `web-ui-` 前缀（例如 `web-ui-usage`），与独立包的原生标识（如 `usage`）相互独立，不会产生 loader entry 重复冲突。宿主服务对同类插件会自动去重。通常情况下安装全家桶即可满足完整需求，无需重复安装单个子包。\n\n</details>\n\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何通过手机或平板远程访问 DeepSeek Harness？是否必须在同一 Wi-Fi 下？</strong></summary>\n\n手机远程访问基于配对令牌安全门控。若手机与运行 DSH 的电脑处于同一局域网（Wi-Fi），电脑端点击侧边栏手机图标弹出二维码，手机直接扫码即可打开完整的移动端交互界面。若需要公网跨网络访问（例如在户外使用移动蜂窝网络访问家中电脑），可搭配 Cloudflare Tunnel（例如 cloudflared）或 Tailscale 将 DSH 端口穿透至公网，手机打开公网链接配对访问即可，通信全程走鉴权通道，未配对请求将被严格拦截。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>关闭浏览器或电脑休眠后，DeepSeek 的定时任务还会继续运行吗？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，关闭浏览器标签页不影响定时任务的触发与执行。但如果整机进入深度睡眠或关机，宿主进程将暂停运行，离线期间错过的触发点会遵循跳过策略处理。若希望保持无人值守后台自动化，可在任务看板设置中开启“电源保护”选项，该选项会阻止系统因空闲进入休眠（允许显示器正常熄灭），确保定时任务准时触发。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何查看和监控 DeepSeek 及其他模型 API 的 Token 消耗与账户余额？</strong></summary>\n\n安装使用统计插件后，在“设置 > 使用统计”面板中可查看按日汇总的输入、输出与缓存 Token 数量，支持按模型细分查看 30 天消费趋势。针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费估算；若配置了支持查询余额的供应商 API，插件可定时拉取当前账户剩余额度与重置周期。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>多个 AI 智能体（Agent）并发编码时，如何避免 Git 分支和代码冲突？</strong></summary>\n\n直接在单一 Git 工作区并发运行多个智能体容易导致代码互相覆盖。使用全家桶内置的 Git 图谱插件，可以在新建会话时自动或手动创建独立的 Git Worktree。每个智能体会话在各自专属的分支和物理目录中独立运行、提交修改，彻底隔绝主工作区文件，开发完成后可在图谱面板中清晰比对并合并分支。\n\n</details>\n\n## 已知限制\n\n- 任务看板由后端 Host 进程统一调度，关闭前端标签页不影响任务执行；但若宿主进程停止或操作系统关机睡眠，处于离线期间的触发点将直接跳过不补跑。可选的电源保护仅阻止系统闲置睡眠，无法阻止用户主动合盖、手动休眠或电源切断，技术细节见 [dsh-task-board README](packages/dsh-task-board/README.zh.md)。\n- SSH 凭据（密码与私钥口令）保存在本地 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 文件中（文件权限为 0600）；在网络中断重连时可能重新发送非幂等命令，终端输出保持原样返回不执行脱敏，安全规范见 [dsh-ssh README](packages/dsh-ssh/README.zh.md)。\n- 移动端流式输出经隧道或固定域名中继转发，广域网往返延迟叠加在每次更新上；固定域名中继比裸快速隧道多一跳，两者都可用。\n- 从源码构建全仓需要 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm 工具链，直接从 npm 安装不受此限制。\n\n## 社区\n\n欢迎加入社区交流群，与开发者及其他用户探讨使用技巧、反馈使用问题或提出新功能建议。\n\n扫描下方二维码加入“DSH Web 交流群”：\n\n<img src=\"docs/community-center.jpg\" alt=\"DeepSeek Harness       "path": "packages/dsh-skill-explorer/README.zh.md",
      "content": "# dsh-skill-explorer · DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Skill 技能与工具资源可视化浏览器\n\n[English](README.md) | 中文\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer?style=flat-square\" alt=\"Version\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.1--rc.3-4c6ef5?style=flat-square&labelColor=454a54\" alt=\"DSH\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square\" alt=\"License\">\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>DeepSeek Harness（DSH）官方 Web GUI 与桌面客户端专属技能中心与 Skill 管理面板</strong><br>\n  <em>按来源层级浏览 · 一键启闭模型调用 · 可视化新建/编辑 SKILL.md · 安全回收站 · 零侵入管理</em>\n</p>\n\nDSH Web GUI 与官方桌面客户端的**技能中心**：按来源分级浏览已加载的全部 skill，启用/禁用模型调用，创建新技能，删除技能（移入可恢复的回收站）。\n\n## 功能\n\n- 侧边栏「技能中心」一行（位于 shell 自己的面板列表，与插件、定时、任务看板\n  并列），打开的是**原生中栏页面**，带页签栏。该行负责打开面板，打开任意会话\n  （或新建对话）即让中栏回到会话正文，与官方插件页、定时任务页一致；页面自身\n  不再提供「返回会话」控件。\n- **技能 tab**：按来源分级展示（系统内置 / 项目 `.dsh/skills` / 项目\n  `.agents/skills` / 自定义目录 / 用户 `~/.dsh/skills` / 用户\n  `~/.agents/skills` / 运行时注册），顶部搜索框按技能名或描述即时过滤\n  （名称命中排在前面，Esc 清空），并与工作区选择叠加生效；\n  每行显示描述、适用场景、可调用标记、启用/禁用开关（改写 SKILL.md\n  frontmatter 的 `disable-model-invocation`，模型目录热刷新；插件提供的文件\n  没有这条可写路径，其开关改由面板自己的存储记录）、复制为模板入口（把该技能复制为\n  创建表单的起点）、编辑入口与删除按钮\n  （文件移入 `.trash`，可恢复）；加载进行中隐藏刷新按钮。\n- **筛选与来源折叠**：搜索框与三个筛选维度叠加——要显示的来源分组、启用/禁用\n  状态、行的标记（「由插件提供」/「无本地文件」/「软链接」）——由一个工具栏\n  开关统一展开，开关上显示当前有几个维度在收窄列表。每个来源分组的标题可\n  展开/收起；首次使用时只展开项目与用户根，因此全局来源不会一次铺满所有行。\n  筛选维度与折叠决定都是存在 `localStorage` 的视图偏好；拒绝存储的浏览器\n  只是不记忆它们。\n- **导入 tab**：从宿主机上的目录或浏览器读取的 `.zip` 压缩包批量创建技能。\n  每个候选都按官方接受规则校验，并按与列表相同的来源 rank 裁决，因此更强来源\n  已提供的同名候选会报告为跳过，而不是创建一个模型收不到的文件。导入只新建\n  文件：已有技能不会被覆盖。\n- **创建 tab**：表单创建新技能，可写入用户根（`~/.dsh/skills`）或项目根\n  （`.dsh/skills`），生成标准 SKILL.md。\n- **编辑 tab**：从行内编辑入口打开，先经宿主读取该技能（列表只带元数据），\n  再就地改写描述、适用场景与正文；技能名、位置与启用状态保持不变。\n- 数据来自按官方 dsh-skill-filesystem 根约定的文件系统扫描，并与\n  `ctx.skills` 注册表（bundled / runtime 条目）合并。扫描既读本插件自己的\n  `customSkillDirs`，也读每一条在用的 `skill-filesystem` loader 行的同名\n  配置，因此官方文档推荐的配法（写在 profile patch 的 provider 行上）同样可管理。\n  本插件不改变 skill 的加载/注入语义——纯 GUI 管理层。\n- 写路由无法操作的技能会按它实际的本地形态打标，而不是静默缺失控件：\n  插件 provider 报告了真实指令文件（官方 `SkillSummary.path`）的技能显示为\n  **「由插件提供」**——文件确实存在，只是不在本面板扫描的技能根目录下；\n  只有完全没有文件的注册项才显示为 **「无本地文件」**。两者都不带可写路径，\n  因此都不会出现必然 404 的编辑/删除控件。**「由插件提供」**的行带有启用/\n  禁用开关（#1854）：文件属于 provider，因此宿主把开关记在面板自己的存储里，\n  该行显示为已停用（见「已知限制」）；只有**「无本地文件」**的行完全没有开关。\n- 只有官方 provider 会加载的技能才被列出：SKILL.md 必须声明非空的 `name`\n  与 `description`，且 name 满足官方技能名文法。被官方 provider 丢弃的文件\n  在面板里同样不出现，面板不会展示模型收不到的技能。\n- 同名技能按官方来源 rank 决出胜者（项目 `.dsh/skills` 100、项目\n  `.agents/skills` 200、运行时 250、自定义目录 300、用户 `~/.dsh/skills`\n  400、用户 `~/.agents/skills` 500、内置 600），因此面板所示与模型所得是\n  同一个技能。\n\n## 安装\n\n### 从 npm（推荐）\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer@latest\n```\n\n### 从仓库（开发）\n\n```sh\ngit clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git\ncd dsh-web\npnpm install\npnpm -r build\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-skill-explorer\n```\n\n安装后重启 `dsh web`，侧边栏出现「技能中心」入口。\n\n## 路由\n\n| 路由 | 方法 | 说明 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/list` | GET | 分级技能列表 |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/read` | GET | 单个技能的可编辑字段与正文（`?name=&path=`） |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/set-enabled` | POST | 启用/禁用（改写 frontmatter） |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/set-provider-enabled` | POST | 启用/禁用插件提供的技能（记入面板自己的存储） |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/create` | POST | 创建技能（user/project 根） |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/import` | POST | 从目录或 .zip 压缩包批量创建技能 |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/update` | POST | 原地修改已有技能（名称与位置不变） |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/delete` | POST | 删除（移入 .trash） |\n| `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/health` | GET | 健康检查 |\n\n## 安全模型\n\n- 全部 `/api/dsh-skill-explorer/*` 路由默认仅限 loopback（插件家族共享围栏：\n  loopback 套接字 + Host 头 + 浏览器同源标记）：未配对的局域网客户端在任何\n  技能文件访问前即收到 `403 forbidden: loopback-only`。同时装了\n  `dsh-remote-web-ui` 时，有效的已配对设备 cookie 是额外放行路径（与\n  `api/gate` 检查同一枚 cookie）；未配对与已撤销设备仍 403。技能中心不硬依赖\n  远程插件。\n- 写路由仅把面板展示的路径作为身份声明；执行修改前，最新文件系统扫描必须解析到\n  同名且路径完全一致的技能。任意路径与过期的同名回退都会被拒绝，因此项目技能\n  消失后，尚未执行的操作不会改到同名的用户级或自定义技能。read 路由走同一套\n  解析，因此也无法用来读取任意路径。该解析所用扫描按与 list 路由完全相同的顺序\n  确定工作区（显式覆盖、活动会话工作区、进程 cwd），因此写操作不会重新扫描到与\n  面板展示不同的项目根。\n- update 路由原地改写已有 SKILL.md，不改技能名与位置，并原样保留当前的\n  `disable-model-invocation` 值，因此编辑不会静默把已禁用的技能重新启用。\n  与删除同理，链接技能在该路由上被拒绝（见下）。\n- 插件技能开关路由把每条记录以 `(provider, 技能名)` 组合写入\n  `$DSH_HOME/dsh-skill-explorer/provider-toggles.json`（临时文件 + fsync +\n  rename 原子落盘；损坏、异构或超限的文档降级为「什么都没停用」）。该路由\n  既不接收也不写入路径：客户端只发送身份，不发送位置。停用要求最新一次收集\n  仍能把该组合解析为 `provider-file` 行，因此存储里只可能出现面板确实展示过\n  的身份；启用只做删除记录，故无条件放行——插件卸载后残留的记录仍可清除。\n  两个方向都是幂等的，重复点击或重试不会堆出重复记录。\n- 导入路由是唯一会读取技能根之外内容的创建入口，其读取面很窄：用户指定的\n  宿主机目录只扫描一层 `<名称>/SKILL.md` 或 `<名称>.md`，其中的符号链接与\n A root-absolute `/api/...` escapes that prefix and the\n * request never reaches the plugin's route (issue #1707); the official client\n * posts its own routes the same way (`api/session.list`).\n */\nconst API = {\n  list: 'api/dsh-skill-explorer/list',\n  read: 'api/dsh-skill-explorer/read',\n  setEnabled: 'api/dsh-skill-explorer/set-enabled',\n  setProviderEnabled: 'api/dsh-skill-explorer/set-provider-enabled',\n  create: 'api/dsh-skill-explorer/create',\n  update: 'api/dsh-skill-explorer/update',\n  delete: 'api/dsh-skill-explorer/delete',\n  import: 'api/dsh-skill-explorer/import',\n} as const\n\n/**\n * What backs a skill locally (host-classified).\n *\n * - `editable`: a filesystem scan resolved the SKILL.md; `path` is writable.\n * - `provider-file`: a plugin provider reports a real instruction file the\n *   panel's scan did not resolve. (#1854).\n * - `virtual`: no instruction file exists; \"no local file\" is accurate.\n */\nexport type SkillFileState = 'editable' | 'provider-file' | 'virtual'\n\n/** One skill entry as served by the host. */\nexport interface SkillEntry {\n  name: string\n  description: string\n  whenToUse?: string\n  provider?: string\n  level: string\n  path?: string\n  /** What backs this skill locally (see       "content": "/**\n * Browser-half entry for the dsh-skill-explorer plugin — runs inside the dsh web GUI.\n *\n * Registers the skill-explorer locale dictionaries and mounts the panel as a\n * native center-column page: a row in the shell's own sidebar panel list and a\n * keyed `main` page, both through the official slot seats. The lookup stays lazy so a selection\n  // issued before the service settles still lands once it does, and the face\n  // throws by contract before the layout root entry mounts, which the\n  // controller tolerates.\n  const controller = new PanelController({\n    panel: {\n      select: panelId => {\n        const layout = (ctx as unknown as { get?(name: string): unknown }).get?.('layout') as { selectPanel?: (id: string | null) => void } | undefined\n        layout?.selectPanel?.(panelId)\n      },\n    },\n  })\n  const disposers: Array<() => void> = []\n  try {\n    disposers.push(registerSkillExplorerPanel(ctx, controller, api))\n    // The layout's panel selection is reconciled back into the controller, so\n    // the panel follows the user clicking another panel row.\n    const layoutFace = (ctx as unknown as { get?(name: string): unknown }).get?.('layout') as { panelInfo?: { subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void; getSnapshot(): { activePanelId: unknown } } } | undefined\n    if (layoutFace?.panelInfo !== undefined) {\n      const sync = (): void => {\n        const active = layoutFace.panelInfo!.getSnapshot().activePanelId\n        controller.syncPanelSelection(active === SKILL_EXPLORER_PANEL_ID ?       "content": "/**\n * Native panel registration for the skill center.\n *\n * The panel is an official-style center-column page, not a DOM takeover: it\n * contributes a row into the sidebar shell's own global panel list\n * (`sidebar.panellist`) and its page into the layout's keyed `main` slot. The\n * shell then owns the row box, the label, the active highlight, the collapsed\n * rail and the panel switch, exactly as it does for the shipped Plugins and\n * Schedule pages and for the task board.\n *\n * Both registrations go through `ctx.slots.inject`, which fires only once the\n * owning shell entry has declared the seat: load order between this plugin and\n * ui-layout / ui-sidebar therefore does not matter, and neither does a shell\n * that cannot serve the seats (the callback simply never runs).\n *\n * @module @linxin666/dsh-skill-explorer/client\n */\nimport type { Context as ClientContext } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/client'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar/client'\nimport type { SkillApi } from './api.ts'\nimport { SKILL_EXPLORER_PANEL_ID, type PanelController } from './panel/controller.ts'\nimport { SkillPanel } from './panel/SkillPanel.tsx'\nimport { tt } from './panel-helpers.ts'\nimport css from './panel/panel.module.css'\n\n/** The panel id shared by the sidebar row and the main-slot occupant. */\nexport { SKILL_EXPLORER_PANEL_ID }\n\n/** Row order among the shell's global panel rows (Plugins 0, Schedule 10, board 20). */\nconst PANEL_ORDER = 30\n\n/**\n * The sidebar row glyph the shell asks for at its own size and active state.\n * The shell owns the button, label, tooltip and rail geometry; this component\n * draws only the glyph, like every other panel row.\n *\n * The glyph carries `data-dsh-panel-entry` because it is the only DOM this\n * panel's own code owns inside that shell-owned row: the L2 contract (skins)\n * resolves which row belongs to which plugin through it, since the shell\n * stamps no per-entry hook of its own (see contracts/semantic-attrs-v1.md).\n * @param props - the shell's icon share: square edge and selection state.\n * @returns the decorative skill-center glyph.\n */\nexport function SkillExplorerPanelIcon({ size }: { size: number; active: boolean }): React.ReactElement {\n  return (\n    <svg\n      data-dsh-panel-entry={SKILL_EXPLORER_PANEL_ID}\n      viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\"\n      width={size}\n      height={size}\n      fill=\"none\"\n      stroke=\"currentColor\"\n      strokeWidth=\"1.3\"\n      strokeLinecap=\"round\"\n      strokeLinejoin=\"round\"\n      aria-hidden=\"true\"\n    >\n      <path d=\"M8 3.2C6.6 2 4.5 2 3 2v10.5c1.5 0 3.6 0 5 1.3 1.4-1.3 3.5-1.3 5-1.3V2c-1.5 0-3.6 0-5 1.2z\" />\n      <path d=\"M8 3.2v10.6\" />\n    </svg>\n  )\n}\n\n/**\n * The main-slot page. The layout mounts it only while this panel is selected,\n * so the conversation keeps the center column untouched the rest of the time;\n * the wrapper carries the pinned `data-dsh-skill-explorer-view` semantic\n * anchor (L2 contract, skins) the takeover container used to own.\n * @param props - the framework main-slot share plus this entry's injected face.\n * @returns the skill center page.\n */\nexport function SkillExplorerPanelPage({ controller, api }: { controller: PanelController; api: SkillApi }): React.ReactElement {\n  return (\n    <div className={css.view} data-dsh-skill-explorer-view=\"\" data-dsh-plugin=\"skill-explorer\">\n      <SkillPanel controller={controller} api={api} />\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n/** The injected face both registrations receive. */\ninterface PanelFace {\n  controller: PanelController\n  api: SkillApi\n}\n\n/**\n * Register the skill center's sidebar row and center-column page.\n *\n * Both seats are declared by shell plugins this package does not depend on at\n * runtime, so each registration is wrapped in `ctx.slots.inject`: the callback\n * runs only after the owning entry declares the seat, and a shell that never\n * declares it leaves the panel simply absent instead of failing boot.\n * @param ctx - client root context (services: slots).\n * @param controller - the controller the page and the row drive.\n * @param api - the skill center API client the page operates through.\n * @returns disposer releasing both registrations.\n */\nexport function registerSkillExplorerPanel(ctx: ClientContext, controller: PanelController, api: SkillApi): () => void {\n  const slots = ctx.slots as {\n    inject(key: string, callback: () => () => void): () => void\n    register(options: Record<string, unknown>, component: unknown): () => void\n  }\n  const disposers: Array<() => void> = []\n\n  disposers.push(slots.inject('sidebar.panellist', () => slots.register({\n    name: 'sidebar.panellist',\n    id: SKILL_EXPLORER_PANEL_ID,\n    order: PANEL_ORDER,\n    // The shell resolves this through resolveSlotLabel on every locale change,\n    // so the module-level translate reads the active language at call time.\n    label: () => tt('entry.label'),\n  }, SkillExplorerPanelIcon)))\n\n  disposers.push(slots.inject('main', () => slots.register({\n    name: 'main',\n    key: SKILL_EXPLORER_PANEL_ID,\n    inject: (): PanelFace => ({ controller, api }),\n  }, SkillExplorerPanelPage as never)))\n\n  return () => {\n    for (const dispose of disposers.splice(0)) dispose()\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * Skills tab: the grouped skill list with the search / facet / workspace\n * toolbar, collapsible source groups, and the per-row enable switch, edit,\n * duplicate and delete actions.\n *\n * The host route family is the only data source; a failed refresh keeps the\n * previous payload visible with an inline error. Which facets are applied and\n * which source groups are open are view preferences, not payload state: they\n * are persisted in localStorage (panel-prefs.ts), because the layout unmounts\n * this page whenever another panel takes the center column.\n */\nimport { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'\nimport { SkillApi, type GroupPayload, type ListPayload, type SkillEntry } from '../api.ts'\nimport { zh } from '../locales.ts'\nimport { tt } from '../panel-helpers.ts'\nimport {\n  isGroupExpanded,\n  loadListPrefs,\n  saveListPrefs,\n  toggleGroupCollapsed,\n  type ListViewPrefs,\n  type StorageLike,\n} from '../panel-prefs.ts'\nimport { selectGroups, type SkillListFilter, type SkillMark, type SkillStatus } from '../skill-filter.ts'\nimport type { SkillDraft } from './controller.ts'\nimport css from './panel.module.css'\n\n/** The mark facets, in the order the filter bar lists them. */\nconst MARK_FACETS: readonly SkillMark[] = ['provider-file', 'no-file', 'linked']\n\n/** The enabled/disabled facets, in the order the filter bar lists them. */\nconst STATUS_FACETS: readonly SkillStatus[] = ['all', 'enabled', 'disabled']\n\n/** Localized provider label with fallback to the raw provider id. */\nfunction providerLabel(provider: string): string {\n  const key = `provider.${provider}` as keyof typeof zh\n  return key in zh ? tt(key) : provider\n}\n\n/** Localized source-group title, falling back to the host's own copy. */\nfunction groupTitle(group: GroupPayload): string {\n  const key = `group.${group.key}` as keyof typeof zh\n  return key in zh ? tt(key) : group.title\n}\n\n/** Localized source-group hint, falling back to the host's own copy. */\nfunction groupHintOf(group: GroupPayload): string {\n  const key = `groupHint.${group.key}` as keyof typeof zh\n  return key in zh ? tt(key) : group.hint\n}\n\n/** The browser's localStorage, or undefined when this context refuses it. */\nfunction listStorage(): StorageLike | undefined {\n  try {\n    return typeof localStorage === 'undefined' ? undefined : localStorage\n  } catch {\n    // A sandboxed frame throws on the accessor itself; the tab still works,\n    // it just does not remember the view between visits.\n    return undefined\n  }\n}\n\n/** Whether any facet narrows the list (the source/status/mark facets only). */\nfunction hasActiveFacets(prefs: ListViewPrefs): boolean {\n  return prefs.levels.length > 0 || prefs.status !== 'all' || prefs.marks.length > 0\n}\n\n/** How many facet selections are active, for the toolbar badge. */\nfunction activeFacetCount(prefs: ListViewPrefs): number {\n  return prefs.levels.length + (prefs.status === 'all' ? 0 : 1) + prefs.marks.length\n}\n\n/** The name a duplicate starts from; the user can change it before creating. */\nfunction duplicateSkillName(name: string): string {\n  return `${name}-copy`\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether this row carries an enable switch.\n *\n * A row with a writable path switches by rewriting its own SKILL.md\n * frontmatter. A plugin-provided file (issue #1854) has no such path, so its\n * switch is recorded in the panel's own store; a truly fileless registration\n * has nothing to switch and still shows none.\n * @param skill - the row's entry.\n * @returns whether the row offers the switch.\n */\nfunction canToggle(skill: SkillEntry): boolean {\n  return skill.path !== undefined || skill.fileState === 'provider-file'\n}\n\n/**\n * The local-file badge for a row that the write routes cannot serve.\n *\n * A skill with a plugin-supplied file and a skill with no file at all are\n * different facts (issue #1842): the first is \"Provided by plugin\", only the\n * second is \"No local file\". Both are pathless, so neither offers file\n * controls.\n * @param skill - the row's entry.\n * @returns the badge copy and its tooltip.\n */\nfunction localFileBadge(skill: SkillEntry): { label: string; tooltip: string } {\n  return skill.fileState === 'provider-file'\n    ? { label: tt('list.providerFile'), tooltip: tt('list.providerFileTooltip') }\n    : { label: tt('list.noFile'), tooltip: tt('list.noFileTooltip') }\n}\n\n/** The explanation shown under a row the write routes cannot serve. */\nfunction localFileHint(skill: SkillEntry): string {\n  return skill.fileState === 'provider-file' ? tt('list.providerFileHint') : tt('list.noFileHint')\n}\n\n/** Marks shown next to a skill (model/user invocable). */\nfunction invokableMarks(skill: SkillEntry): string {\n  const marks: string[] = []\n  if (skill.modelInvocable) marks.push(tt('list.mark.model'))\n  if (skill.userInvocable) marks.push(tt('list.mark.user'))\n  return marks.join(' / ')\n}\n\n/** One skill row: name, badges, enable switch, edit, duplicate and delete actions. */\nfunction SkillRow({ skill, api, onChanged, onEdit, onDuplicate }: {\n  skill: SkillEntry\n  api: SkillApi\n  onChanged: () => void\n  onEdit: (skill: SkillEntry) => void\n  onDuplicate: (draft: SkillDraft) => void\n}): React.JSX.Element {\n  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined)\n  // Sync ref guard: React state updates are async, so a double click before\n  // the re-render would fire the same request twice with the stale target.\n  const busyRef = useRef(false)\n\n  const toggle = async (): Promise<void> => {\n    if (busyRef.current || !canToggle(skill)) return\n    busyRef.current = true\n    setBusy(true)\n    setError(undefined)\n    try {\n      // Two identities, one switch: a row with a file certifies the path the\n      // write routes re-scan, a plugin-provided row certifies the\n      // (provider, name) pair the host records in the panel's own store.\n      if (skill.path !== undefined) await api.setEnabled(skill.name, skill.path, !skill.modelInvocable)\n      else await api.setProviderEnabled(skill.name, skill.provider, !skill.modelInvocable)\n      onChanged()\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(tt('list.toggleFailed', { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) }))\n    } finally {\n      busyRef.current = false\n      setBusy(false)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Copy this skill's fields into the create form as a starting point. Do not edit this copy; edit the shared source and run \"node scripts/sync-shared.mjs\".\n/**\n * Anonymous install telemetry shared by the DSH Web UI family plugins.\n *\n * Once per UTC day per browser, each wired plugin sends one heartbeat to\n * the dsh-market edge API listing its package name (and version when known).\n * The payload carries no conversation data and no identifiers beyond a random\n * UUID generated in localStorage; the server hashes it with a deployment salt\n * before storage and never persists IP addresses. Sends are fire-and-forget:\n * failures stay silent and simply retry on a later mount or day. Frames where\n * storage is unavailable report nothing.\n *\n * The family-wide opt-out and the browser's Do Not Track signal both suppress\n * the heartbeat; the Web Plugins settings switch writes the same localStorage\n * key. The system is documented in docs/telemetry.md.\n */\n\nexport type TelemetryChannel = 'market' | 'npm' | 'unknown'\n\nexport interface TelemetryItem {\n  /** npm package name or asset id, e.g. \"@linxin666/dsh-pet\" or \"skin:harbor\". */\n  name: string\n  /** Installed version when known; omitted otherwise. */\n  version?: string\n  /** Install channel when determinable (market = Workshop install). */\n  channel?: TelemetryChannel\n}\n\n/** localStorage key carrying the family-wide telemetry opt-out ('1' = off). */\nexport const TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT_KEY = 'dsh-web-ui-telemetry-opt-out'\n\nconst VISITOR_KEY = 'dsh-web-ui-telemetry-visitor'\nconst DAY_KEY_PREFIX = 'dsh-web-ui-telemetry-day:'\nconst ENDPOINT = 'https://dsh-market.com/api/telemetry/event'\n\n// Baked into each client bundle by shared/tsdown.client.ts (the package's own\n// package.json version at build time). Undefined in dev/test builds.\ndeclare const __DSH_PKG_VERSION__: string | undefined\n\n/** The building package's version, when the bundle carries it. */\nfunction bakedVersion(): string | undefined {\n  try {\n    return typeof __DSH_PKG_VERSION__ === 'string' && __DSH_PKG_VERSION__ !== ''\n      ? __DSH_PKG_VERSION__\n      : undefined\n  } catch {\n    return undefined\n  }\n}\n\n/** Whether the user switched the family-wide opt-out on (reads storage only). */\nexport function isTelemetryOptedOut(): boolean {\n  try {\n    return localStorage.getItem(TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT_KEY) === '1'\n  } catch {\n    // Storage unavailable: there is no stored opt-out to honour.\n    return false\n  }\n}\n\n/** Turn the family-wide opt-out on or off (writing '1' / removing the key); never throws. */\nexport function setTelemetryOptedOut(optedOut: boolean): void {\n  try {\n    if (optedOut) localStorage.setItem(TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT_KEY, '1')\n    else localStorage.removeItem(TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT_KEY)\n  } catch {\n    // Storage unavailable: the preference cannot be persisted on this machine.\n  }\n}\n\n/** Whether the browser itself asks not to be tracked; a failed read means no signal. */\nfunction doNotTrackRequested(): boolean {\n  try {\n    // '1' per the DNT header spec, 'yes' from older Firefox builds.\n    return navigator.doNotTrack === '1' || navigator.doNotTrack === 'yes'\n  } catch {\n    return false\n  }\n}\n\n/** Whether a heartbeat must be suppressed right now: opt-out stored, or the browser asks not to be tracked. */\nexport function isTelemetrySuppressed(): boolean {\n  return isTelemetryOptedOut() || doNotTrackRequested()\n}\n\n/** Read or lazily create the anonymous visitor id; null when storage is unavailable. */\nfunction visitorId(): string | null {\n  try {\n    const existing = localStorage.getItem(VISITOR_KEY)\n    if (existing && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$/.test(existing)) return existing\n    const fresh = crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '')\n    localStorage.setItem(VISITOR_KEY, fresh)\n    return fresh\n  } catch {\n    // Storage unavailable (privacy mode, sandboxed frame): report nothing.\n    return null\n  }\n}\n\n/** Drop stale per-day dedup keys so localStorage does not grow forever. */\nfunction pruneDayKeys(today: string): void {\n  try {\n    for (let index = localStorage.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {\n      const key = localStorage.key(index)\n      if (key !== null && key.startsWith(DAY_KEY_PREFIX) && key !== DAY_KEY_PREFIX + today) {\n        localStorage.removeItem(key)\n      }\n    }\n  } catch { /* best effort */ }\n}\n\n/**\n * Fire the daily heartbeat for the given items at most once per UTC day per\n * browser. Never throws and never blocks the caller. Items without an explicit\n * version inherit the bundle's baked build version.\n */\nexport function reportDailyHeartbeat(items: readonly TelemetryItem[]): void {\n  try {\n    // First guard: a stored opt-out or the browser's Do Not Track stops every\n    // read below from minting an id, marking the day, or reaching the network.\n    if (isTelemetrySuppressed()) return\n    if (items.length === 0) return\n    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)\n    // Automation contexts (CDP-driven QA browsers, fresh isolated profiles)\n    // mint a new visitor id per run and would inflate instance counts.\n    if (navigator.webdriver) return\n    if (localStorage.getItem(DAY_KEY_PREFIX + today) !== null) return\n    const visitor = visitorId()\n    if (visitor === null) return\n    pruneDayKeys(today)\n    const payloadItems = items.map((item) => {\n      const out: Record<string, string> = { name: item.name }\n      const version = item.version ?? bakedVersion()\n      if (version !== undefined) out.version = version\n      if (item.channel !== undefined) out.channel = item.channel\n      return out\n    })\n    const body = JSON.stringify({ kind: 'heartbeat', visitor, items: payloadItems })\n    void fetch(ENDPOINT, {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },\n      body,\n      keepalive: true,\n    }).then((response) => {\n      // Mark the day only after an accepted send, so offline browsers retry\n      // on a later mount instead of going dark until tomorrow.\n      if (response.ok) localStorage.setItem(DAY_KEY_PREFIX + today, '1')\n    }).catch(() => { /* unreachable endpoint: stay silent */ })\n  } catch { /* never break the host UI over telemetry */ }\n}\n"

'./frontmatter.ts'\n// Type-only: the store owns the identity type, so importing it cannot pull\n// the persistence module (which imports isSkillName back from here) into a cycle.\nimport type { Source levels produced by filesystem scanning (registry sources map to the same set). */\nexport const SOURCE_GROUPS: SourceGroup[] = [\n  { key: 'bundled', title: 'System bundled', hint: 'Global skills shipped with DSH and its plugins' },\n  { key: 'project-dsh', title: 'Project skills (.dsh/skills)', hint: 'Located in the project directory, scoped to its workspace' },\n  { key: 'project-agents', title: 'Project skills (.agents/skills)', hint: 'Located in the project directory, scoped to its workspace' },\n  { key: 'custom', title: 'Custom directories', hint: 'customSkillDirs config' },\n  { key: 'user-dsh', title: 'User skills (~/.dsh/skills)', hint: 'Global skills shared by all projects on this machine' },\n  { key: 'user-agents', title: 'User skills (~/.agents/skills)', hint: 'Global skills shared by all projects on this machine' },\n  { key: 'runtime', title: 'Runtime registered', hint: 'Skills registered at runtime by plugins' },\n]\n\n/** Registry source -> display level mapping (unlisted sources fall into \"other\"). */\nexport const REGISTRY_SOURCE_LEVEL: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map(SOURCE_GROUPS.map((group) => [group.key, group.key]))\n\n/**\n * The official skill-name grammar.\n *\n * One definition serves both this scan and the write routes, so a name the\n * panel accepts is one the official registry loads: lowercase alphanumeric\n * segments joined by single hyphens, never a leading, trailing or doubled\n * hyphen. Mirrors isSkillName in @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill.\n */\nconst SKILL_NAME_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/\n\n/**\n * Whether a string is a skill name the official registry accepts.\n * @param name - candidate skill name.\n * @returns whether it matches the official skill-name grammar.\n */\nexport function isSkillName(name: string): boolean {\n  return SKILL_NAME_PATTERN.test(name)\n}\n\n/**\n * Official precedence rank per source (lower wins): the values\n * @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem assigns its roots plus the registry's\n * runtime rank. A duplicate name resolves by this rank across every source the\n * panel shows, so the entry it displays is the one the model receives. Either header is stamped by a\n * hop that forwards traffic, so the request did not originate on this machine.\n * @param request - node HTTP request.\n * @returns true when a forwarding header is present.\n */\nexport function isProxiedRequest(request: IncomingMessage): boolean {\n  return request.headers['cf-connecting-ip'] !== undefined\n    || request.headers['x-forwarded-for'] !== undefined\n}\n\n/**\n * Request-level trust fence: a loopback socket address AND a loopback Host\n * header, plus browser same-origin markers. X-Forwarded-For is therefore never evidence *for* loopback.\n */\nexport function isLoopbackRequest(request: IncomingMessage): boolean {\n  if (!isLoopbackAddress(request.socket.remoteAddress)) return false\n  if (isProxiedRequest(request)) return false\n  const host = request.headers.host\n  if (typeof host !== 'string') return false\n  let hostUrl: URL\n  try {\n    hostUrl = new URL('http://' + host)\n  } catch {\n    return false\n  }\n  if (!isLoopbackHostname(hostUrl.hostname)) return false\n  if (request.headers['sec-fetch-site'] === 'cross-site') return false\n  const origin = request.headers.origin\n  if (origin === undefined) return true\n  try {\n    return new URL(origin).host === hostUrl.host\n  } catch {\n    return false\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether a forwarded request landed on this machine's loopback upstream: a\n * forwarding header (the proxy's own stamp), a loopback socket address (the\n * proxy dials 127.0.0.1:<port>), and a loopback Host header (the proxy rewrote\n * the authority to its upstream literal).\n *\n * This is a fact about the route, not a trust decision.       "content": "/**\n * The panel's own \"switched off\" set for plugin-provided skills.\n *\n * A skill whose instruction file comes from a plugin provider — the registry\n * reports `SkillSummary.path`, but the file sits outside every skill root this\n * panel scans — has no writable path, so the SKILL.md frontmatter switch the\n * other rows use cannot address it (and offering that switch would only produce\n * a 404). This store is the plugin's own answer: one small JSON document under\n * `$DSH_HOME/dsh-skill-explorer/` listing the provider-backed skills the user\n * switched off in the panel, keyed by the stable pair (provider, skill name).\n *\n * It is a PANEL-LOCAL decision: the host registry still loads the skill, so the\n * panel copy and the README say so plainly instead of pretending the model\n * stopped receiving it. What the store does change is this panel's invocable\n * view (see applyProviderToggles in collect.ts), which is the scope the issue\n * accepts.\n *\n * Writes are atomic (unique temp file, fsync, rename), so an interrupted write\n * can never leave a half-written document behind.\n */\n\nimport { mkdir, open, readFile, rename, unlink } from 'node:fs/promises'\nimport { dirname, join } from 'node:path'\nimport { isSkillName } from './collect.ts'\n\n/**\n * Stable identity of one plugin-provided skill in this store.\n *\n * The name alone is not enough: the registry merges by name, but two providers\n * can each supply a file for the same name, and only the pair identifies which\n * one a row shows. An absent provider normalizes to the empty string so the\n * same skill always maps to the same record.\n */\nexport interface ProviderSkillIdentity {\n  /** Official skill name (the grammar isSkillName enforces). */\n  name: string\n  /** Provider id as the registry reports it ('' when it reports none). */\n  provider: string\n}\n\n/** The stored document: the provider-backed skills the user switched off. */\nexport interface ProviderToggleDocument {\n  version: 1\n  disabled: ProviderSkillIdentity[]\n}\n\n/**\n * Bound on the stored set. The panel only ever offers a switch for a skill it\n * lists, so a healthy installation holds a handful of records; the cap keeps a\n * corrupt or hand-edited document from growing without limit.\n */\nconst MAX_DISABLED = 512\n\n/**\n * Bound on one provider id. Cordis provider ids are short module or plugin\n * names; a longer value is not a provider id this store will record.\n */\nconst MAX_PROVIDER_LENGTH = 200\n\n/** Per-process counter so two concurrent writes never share a temp file name. */\nlet tempSeq = 0\n\n/** Store file location: $DSH_HOME/dsh-skill-explorer/provider-toggles.json. */\nexport function providerToggleFile(dshHome: string): string {\n  return join(dshHome, 'dsh-skill-explorer', 'provider-toggles.json')\n}\n\n/** The document a panel that has never been switched off reads as. */\nexport function emptyProviderToggles(): ProviderToggleDocument {\n  return { version: 1, disabled: [] }\n}\n\n/**\n * Normalize a submitted identity, or reject it.\n *\n * The name must satisfy the official skill grammar (the same one the scan and\n * the file write routes apply), and the provider must be a short id: both are\n * written into the store verbatim, so an unbounded or ungrammatical value would\n * be a record no row could ever match.\n * @param name - candidate skill name from the panel.\n * @param provider - candidate provider id (optional).\n * @returns the normalized identity, or undefined when it is not storable.\n */\nexport function providerSkillIdentity(name: string, provider?: string): ProviderSkillIdentity | undefined {\n  if (!isSkillName(name)) return undefined\n  const id = typeof provider === 'string' ? provider.trim() : ''\n  if (id.length > MAX_PROVIDER_LENGTH) return undefined\n  return { name, provider: id }\n}\n\n/** Map key for one identity; JSON keeps the pair unambiguous for any provider id. */\nfunction keyOf(identity: ProviderSkillIdentity): string {\n  return JSON.stringify([identity.provider, identity.name])\n}\n\n/**\n * Total order over identities (plain comparison, never locale-dependent), so\n * the stored document reads like the skill list: by name, then by provider.\n */\nfunction compareIdentities(left: ProviderSkillIdentity, right: ProviderSkillIdentity): number {\n  if (left.name !== right.name) return left.name < right.name ? -1 : 1\n  if (left.provider !== right.provider) return left.provider < right.provider ? -1 : 1\n  return 0\n}\n\n/**\n * Tolerant deserialize: a missing, corrupt, or foreign document reads as \"no\n * skill switched off\", which is the state a fresh install is in. Records that\n * no row could match (an ungrammatical name, an over-long provider id, a\n * duplicate) are dropped rather than carried forward.\n * @param raw - file text.\n * @returns the usable records, de-duplicated, bounded and sorted.\n */\nexport function deserializeProviderToggles(raw: string): ProviderToggleDocument {\n  let parsed: unknown\n  try {\n    parsed = JSON.parse(raw)\n  } catch {\n    return emptyProviderToggles()\n  }\n  if (typeof parsed !== 'object' || parsed === null) return emptyProviderToggles()\n  const doc = parsed as { version?: unknown; disabled?: unknown }\n  if (doc.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(doc.disabled)) return emptyProviderToggles()\n  const seen = new Set<string>()\n  const disabled: ProviderSkillIdentity[] = []\n  for (const value of doc.disabled) {\n    if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) continue\n    const entry = value as { name?: unknown; provider?: unknown }\n    if (typeof entry.name !== 'string' || typeof entry.provider !== 'string') continue\n    const identity = providerSkillIdentity(entry.name, entry.provider)\n    if (identity === undefined) continue\n    const key = keyOf(identity)\n    if (seen.has(key)) continue\n    seen.add(key)\n    disabled.push(identity)\n    if (disabled.length >= MAX_DISABLED) break\n  }\n  return { version: 1, disabled: disabled.sort(compareIdentities) }\n}\n\n/** Serialize the document in the shape deserializeProviderToggles accepts. */\nexport function serializeProviderToggles(doc: ProviderToggleDocument): string {\n  return JSON.stringify({ version: 1, disabled: doc.disabled }, null, 1)\n}\n\n/**\n * Read the store for a panel request.\n *\n * An unreadable file degrades to the empty document on purpose: the panel then\n * shows every provider skill as enabled, which is the state before the user\n * ever used the switch, instead of failing the whole list route.\n * @param dshHome - the DSH home root.\n * @returns the records the panel currently honors.\n */\nexport async function readProviderToggles(dshHome: string): Promise<ProviderToggleDocument> {\n  try {\n    return deserializeProviderToggles(await readFile(providerToggleFile(dshHome), 'utf8'))\n  } catch {\n    return emptyProviderToggles()\n  }\n}\n\n/** Atomic JSON write: unique temp file, fsync, rename. */\nasync function writeJsonAtomic(path: string, value: string): Promise<void> {\n  await mkdir(dirname(path), { recursive: true })\n  tempSeq += 1\n  const temp = `${path}.${process.pid}.${tempSeq}.tmp`\n  try {\n    const handle = await open(temp, 'w')\n    try {\n      await handle.writeFile(value, 'utf8')\n      await handle.sync()\n    } finally {\n      await handle.close()\n    }\n    await rename(temp, path)\n  } catch (error) {\n    await unlink(temp).catch(() => {})\n    throw error\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Record (or clear) the panel-local switch for one provider-backed skill.\n *\n * Both directions are idempotent: switching the same skill off twice keeps one\n * record instead of stacking duplicates, and switching on a skill that is not\n * stored leaves the file untouched. A no-op write is skipped so an unchanged\n * panel never rewrites the document.\n * @param dshHome - the DSH home root.\n * @param identity - the normalized provider-backed skill identity.\n * @param enabled - true to enable (drop the record), false to disable.\n * @returns the document as it stands after the call.\n */\nexport async function setProviderSkillEnabled(\n  dshHome: string,\n  identity: ProviderSkillIdentity,\n  enabled: boolean,\n): Promise<ProviderToggleDocument> {\n  const doc = await readProviderToggles(dshHome)\n  const stored = doc.disabled.some((entry) => keyOf(entry) === keyOf(identity))\n  if (stored === !enabled) return doc\n  const disabled = (enabled\n    ? doc.disabled.filter((entry) => keyOf(entry) !== keyOf(identity))\n    : [...doc.disabled, identity]\n  ).sort(compareIdentities)\n  const next: ProviderToggleDocument = { version: 1, disabled }\n  await writeJsonAtomic(providerToggleFile(dshHome), serializeProviderToggles(next))\n  return next\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * The /api/dsh-skill-explorer route family: list (grouped by source), read\n * (one skill's editable fields and body), set enabled (rewrites SKILL.md\n * frontmatter), set provider enabled (records a panel-local switch for a\n * plugin-provided skill, which has no writable path), create, update (rewrites\n * an existing SKILL.md in place), delete (move to .trash), import (batch-create\n * skills from a directory or a .zip archive) and health. Every route carries\n * the shared trust fence (loopback by default; a live\n * paired-device cookie is an extra allow\n * path when remote-web-ui is loaded) plus browser same-origin markers — the\n * write routes touch real skill files, so unpaired LAN clients must not reach\n * them, and read/update only touch paths a fresh scan resolves. Import is the\n * one creation surface that reads a source outside the skill roots (see\n * import.ts): it writes only new files under the chosen root and never\n * mutates an existing one.\n */\n\nimport { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from 'node:http'\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport type { WebRoute } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver'\nimport { isSkillExplorerAllowed } from './access.ts'\nimport { buildPayload, collectSkills, findProjectRoot, isSkillName, overwriteSkillFile, projectSkillRoot, trashSkillFile, userSkillRoot, writeSkillFile, type CollectOptions, type SkillEntry } from './collect.ts'\nimport { parseFrontmatter, setFrontmatterField, stripFrontmatter } from './frontmatter.ts'\nimport { readJsonBody, writeJson } from './http.ts'\nimport { IMPORT_LIMITS, ImportRequestError, importSkills, type ImportSource } from './import.ts'\nimport { providerSkillIdentity, readProviderToggles, setProviderSkillEnabled, type ProviderSkillIdentity } from './provider-toggles.ts'\n\n/** Route paths (client bundle mirrors these literals; tests assert both sides). */\nexport const ROUTES = {\n  list: '/api/dsh-skill-explorer/list',\n  read: '/api/dsh-skill-explorer/read',\n  setEnabled: '/api/dsh-skill-explorer/set-enabled',\n  setProviderEnabled: '/api/dsh-skill-explorer/set-provider-enabled',\n  create: '/api/dsh-skill-explorer/create',\n  update: '/api/dsh-skill-explorer/update',\n  delete: '/api/dsh-skill-explorer/delete',\n  import: '/api/dsh-skill-explorer/import',\n  health: '/api/dsh-skill-explorer/health',\n} as const\n\n/** Largest import request body: the archive cap plus base64 expansion and JSON. */\nconst IMPORT_BODY_MAX_BYTES = Math.ceil(IMPORT_LIMITS.archiveBytes / 3) * 4 + 64 * 1024\n\n/** Base64 payload guard: rejects a body that is not a base64 string at all. */\nconst BASE64_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/u\n\n/** URL query helper (first value, decoded). */\nfunction queryParam(url: URL, name: string): string | undefined {\n  const value = url.searchParams.get(name)\n  return value === null ? undefined : value\n}\n\n/** Route family dependencies (tests inject fakes). */\nexport interface SkillRoutesDeps {\n  /** User dsh config root (~/.dsh). */\n  dshHome: string\n  /** User agents config root (~/.agents). */\n  agentsHome: string\n  /**\n   * Extra custom skill roots. A resolver rather than a fixed list because the\n   * host reads them off the live `skill-filesystem` loader rows, which a\n   * profile reload can replace between requests.\n   */\n  customSkillDirs: string[] | (() => string[])\n  /** ctx.skills registry (snapshot). */\n  registry: CollectOptions['registry']\n  /** Active session cwd list (project root base). */\n  activeSessionCwds(): string[]\n  /** Logger. */\n  logger: { warn(error: unknown): void }\n}\n\n/** Default process cwd fallback (overridable in tests). */\nexport const DEFAULT_CWD = (): string => process.cwd()\n\n/**\n * Narrow the request's import source.\n *\n * The body carries either a host directory the user typed or an archive the\n * browser read and base64-encoded; anything else is a client-shape error, and\n * returning the message here keeps the route's error branch a single\n * condition.\n * @param source - the raw `source` field.\n * @returns the resolved source, or a message describing what is wrong.\n */\nfunction resolveImportSource(source: unknown): ImportSource | string {\n  if (typeof source !== 'object' || source === null || Array.isArray(source)) {\n    return 'source must be { kind: \"directory\", path } or { kind: \"archive\", data }'\n  }\n  const record = source as Record<string, unknown>\n  if (record.kind === 'directory') {\n    const path = record.path\n    if (typeof path !== 'string' || path.trim() === '') return 'source.path is required for a directory import'\n    return { kind: 'directory', path: path.trim() }\n  }\n  if (record.kind === 'archive') {\n    const data = record.data\n    if (typeof data !== 'string' || data === '') return 'source.data is required for an archive import'\n    if (!BASE64_PATTERN.test(data)) return 'source.data must be a base64 string'\n    const decoded = Buffer.from(data, 'base64')\n    if (decoded.length === 0) return 'source.data decoded to an empty archive'\n    if (decoded.length > IMPORT_LIMITS.archiveBytes) {\n      return `archive exceeds the ${IMPORT_LIMITS.archiveBytes} byte import limit`\n    }\n    return { kind: 'archive', data: decoded }\n  }\n  return 'source.kind must be \"directory\" or \"archive\"'\n}\n\n/**\n * Build every /api/dsh-skill-explorer route (exact paths).\n * @param ctx - host context; may expose remoteWebUiPairing.\n * @param deps - agentsHome, registry, activeSessionCwds, logger } = deps\n\n  /** Resolve the configured custom roots (degraded to [] when the resolver throws). */\n  const resolveCustomSkillDirs = (): string[] => {\n    try {\n      const dirs = typeof deps.customSkillDirs === 'function' ? deps.customSkillDirs() : deps.customSkillDirs\n      return Array.isArray(dirs) ? dirs : []\n    } catch {\n      return []\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Guard helper: fence + method check. */\n  const guard = (req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, method: string): boolean => {\n    if (!isSkillExplorerAllowed(ctx, req)) activeSessionCwds()\n    } catch {\n      return []\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Active session project roots (degraded to [] when sessions throw). */\n  const sessionProjectRoots = (): string[] => {\n    try {\n      return safeSessionCwds().map((sessionCwd) => findProjectRoot(sessionCwd))\n    } catch {\n      return []\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Collect options shared by list/set-enabled/set-provider-enabled/delete/\n   * health handlers.\n   *\n   * The panel's provider-skill switches are read per request (not captured at\n   * mount) so a toggle the user just made is honored by the very next list,\n   * and a restart picks the stored set back up.\n   */\n  const collectOptions = async (cwd: string): Promise<CollectOptions> => ({\n    cwd,\n    projectRoots: sessionProjectRoots(),\n    customSkillDirs: resolveCustomSkillDirs(),\n    dshHome,\n    agentsHome,\n    registry,\n    providerDisabledSkills: (await readProviderToggles(dshHome)).disabled,\n The write routes used the process cwd alone, so on a host whose cwd\n   * is the DSH install directory they scanned a different project root than\n   * the list route had just served and reported 409 for a skill the panel was\n   * displaying.\n   */\n  const panelCwd = (override?: string): string =>\n    (override !== undefined && override.trim() !== '' ? override : undefined)\n    ?? safeSessionCwds()[0]\n    ?? DEFAULT_CWD()\n\n  /** Find a skill by name from a fresh collection pass (trusts scanned paths only). */\n  const findSkill = async (name: string, cwd: string): Promise<SkillEntry | undefined> => {\n    const { skills } = await collectSkills(await collectOptions(cwd))\n    return skills.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Find a currently listed plugin-provided skill by its stable identity.\n   *\n   * The write route for the panel-local switch has no path to certify, so it\n   * uses the identity the panel displayed: a fresh collection must resolve the\n   * same (provider, name) pair to a `provider-file` row.
